task: Team-lead smoke: the outbox worker must not write personal data or credentials from error objects into hosted logs. Its pino logger currently serializes raw errors (message, stack and pg fields such as detail) to Render logs.

interface_contract.src/log_redaction.ts: export function errorLogSerializer(err: unknown): Record<string, unknown>. Start from pino.stdSerializers.err, then scrub every string value (recursively, including message, stack, detail, hint, where, cause and custom properties) with scrubText from src/error_monitoring.ts. Keep type, code and UUIDs. Bound total size. Never throw.
interface_contract.src/worker.ts: export the worker's pino instance as `logger`, created with serializers { err: errorLogSerializer }.

assignments.scope: Implementation: error log serializer and worker logger wiring
dod: src/worker.ts exports `logger` using the serializer; no behaviour change besides serialization
worker test group passes on a disposable PostgreSQL

assignments.scope: Adversarial tests written from the interface contract, in parallel with B1
assignments.dependency_note: Authoring is parallel against the fixed interface contract; only the passing run depends on B1's integrated result.
dod: hostile pg-style and nested errors carry email, phone, card, JWT, bearer, password and IP values; none survive serialization
type, code and UUID correlation ids survive
the live worker logger's err serializer is errorLogSerializer
serializer never throws on hostile input (circular, getters that throw, huge strings)
test fails when scrubbing is removed (mutation check by the lead)

assignments.scope: Re-plan after B2's findings: fix scrubText's pre-scrub cut in the shared redaction module (a secret straddling the cut survived as a prefix)
dod: the trailing partial token is dropped before scrubbing
a regression fixture that fails without the fix and passes with it

dod: verdict with concrete failure scenarios for every finding; no blocking finding open at merge

replan_log: B2's adversarial tests: 21/23 passed against B1. Two real leaks were found: (1) credential-named keys such as cookie, set-cookie, authorization and x-api-key were written whole; (2) scrubText cut the text before scrubbing, so a straddling secret survived as a prefix.
Finding (1) is in B1's scope and was returned to B1. Finding (2) is in src/error_monitoring.ts, which no builder held; it was added as B3 (lead), and R1 and R2 review it.
